report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300s window (2026-09-28T10:43:48Z to 10:48:48Z) the sampled traces show a real failure mode touching checkout's call path: checkout client spans for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart carry error=true / otel.status_code=ERROR / rpc.grpc.status_code=9 in traces ac8a2b166ab5a335d513754156c675ba, 2d425d38e95f0482691ee13c88418ba7 and 00ee8a9a3839ec96dd8250a53383ef22, and the corresponding cart server spans 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart' report Grpc.Core.RpcException FailedPrecondition 'Can't access cart storage ... Wasn't able to connect to redis'. Those affected checkout spans are far slower than the checkout PlaceOrder spans that succeeded in the same window (147.8s/146.8s/119.6s vs 47-98ms), and one load-generator POST span shows HTTP 504 after 15.0s (trace 5236d4d9c0793ef5742112be604799f2); the frontend-proxy 'ingress' and load-generator 'POST' span-metric ERROR series are non-zero (8.75). However, the checkout span-metric ERROR series itself returns 0 for PlaceOrder, PaymentService/Charge and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, and checkout's rpc_client counters show only rpc_grpc_status_code=0 as non-zero, so 'elevated checkout errors' is only partially corroborated: the visible failures are on checkout's cart/redis dependency leg, and the checkout error-metric view is internally inconsistent and has no pre-window baseline. Payment, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email spans in the samples show no error status tags.

claims.text: Three spans of service checkout in the window are client spans for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code=9, in traces ac8a2b166ab5a335d513754156c675ba, 2d425d38e95f0482691ee13c88418ba7 and 00ee8a9a3839ec96dd8250a53383ef22, with durations 147,832,706 us, 146,807,148 us and 119,639,596 us respectively.

Spans of service cart in the window with operation 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart' carry error=true / otel.status_code=ERROR plus an exception detail 'Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis ... ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCartAsync")' in traces ac8a2b166ab5a335d513754156c675ba, 2d425d38e95f0482691ee13c88418ba7, 00ee8a9a3839ec96dd8250a53383ef22 and 7db8519ed45f7261258edb32e3916ea0, with durations 147,830,668 us, 146,804,924 us, 119,637,643 us and 105,366,804 us.

Supplied parent references in trace ac8a2b166ab5a335d513754156c675ba give the visible edge checkout PlaceOrder span d472dd9a3462c7cc -> checkout EmptyCart client span 1baf3285ca245530 -> cart server span 99260c0057a3aa4c (both child spans declare refType CHILD_OF with parent_is_visible=true).

Other checkout PlaceOrder spans in the same window completed with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and durations of 97,682 us, 74,829 us, 61,635 us, 59,734 us and 47,417 us (traces d29b0d69fa9d6199473645f23ec2c140, 95f93322d04892dc3c50eac5fa685ca4, d61a1672db47ea4cbdb0e420db469f78, 69dd7e4476dcad53d0611aff171bc66e and e3986cf1b5e3c3bf0257e749cbf263eb), so the errored PlaceOrder durations of 119-148 s are roughly three orders of magnitude above the successful PlaceOrder spans in this same window.

The traces_span_metrics_calls_total series returned for service_name=checkout with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR have value 0 over the window for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, while their STATUS_CODE_UNSET counterparts are 6.25, 11.25 and 15.0.

For service_name=checkout the rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count increases in the window are non-zero only for rpc_grpc_status_code=0 (Charge 13.75, Convert 33.75, EmptyCart 6.25, GetCart 13.75, GetProduct 20.0, GetQuote 13.75, ShipOrder 13.75), while rpc_grpc_status_code=13 GetProduct and rpc_grpc_status_code=2 Charge are returned as 0.
Non-zero span-metric ERROR counts exist in the window for frontend-proxy span_name 'ingress' (8.75) and load-generator span_name 'POST' (8.75), while load-generator span_name 'GET' ERROR is 0.
A span of service load-generator in trace 5236d4d9c0793ef5742112be604799f2 has operation 'POST', status_tags error=true, http.status_code 504 and otel.status_code ERROR, with duration 15,003,954 us.

Payment spans in the sample (service payment, operation grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge and child operation charge) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations from 1,481 us to 6,924 us (e.g. traces d29b0d69fa9d6199473645f23ec2c140 and 2d425d38e95f0482691ee13c88418ba7).
Product-catalog spans in the sample (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and ListProducts) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations from 78 us to 7,925 us.
Shipping spans in the sample (oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and child POST spans) carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and http.status_code 200 with durations from 4,218 us to 29,297 us.
Currency spans in the sample (Currency/Convert) carry otel.status_code OK and rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations from 545 us to 4,849 us.
Email spans in the sample (POST /send_order_confirmation and send_email) carry http.status_code 200 with durations from 756 us to 17,080 us.

The checkout EmptyCart failures most plausibly originate on the cart/redis leg rather than in checkout's own logic: the failing cart server span self-reports a redis connection failure from ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCartAsync, and the checkout span is its visible parent. This is inferred from error text only; no redis/valkey metrics or logs are available inside the authorized metric set to confirm the dependency's state.

The 'elevated checkout errors' reading is contradicted by the span-metric view of the same window: checkout's own STATUS_CODE_ERROR series are returned as 0 (PlaceOrder, PaymentService/Charge, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct), checkout's rpc_client counters show only rpc_grpc_status_code=0 as non-zero, and no ERROR series exists for checkout span_name oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, even though sampled checkout spans in the same window are tagged ERROR. The two views are not reconcilable from the delivered evidence.

Not supported: that checkout's dependency calls to payment (Charge) and product-catalog (GetProduct) were failing in this window. Their checkout-side span-metric ERROR series read 0, their rpc_client non-zero counts are status 0 only, and the sampled payment and product-catalog spans all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0. Absence in a biased sample is not proof of health, but these specific error counters are returned as 0 rather than missing.

gaps: No pre-window or baseline window was queried, so 'elevated' latency cannot be established as a trend; only absolute durations and an in-window comparison between errored and successful PlaceOrder spans are supported.

The checkout span-metric STATUS_CODE_ERROR series return 0 while sampled checkout spans are tagged ERROR in the same window; the reason (aggregation labelling, series lag, or sampling of the trace view) is not determinable from the delivered evidence.

Trace evidence is a bounded biased sample: the checkout view had spans_omitted=492, the cart view was truncated with spans_omitted=445, and the views return at most 20 spans, so full error rates and complete call chains cannot be computed.
The parent of the checkout PlaceOrder spans is not visible (parent_is_visible=false), so the upstream frontend leg of the failing requests is unknown.
No redis/valkey metric series are present in the authorized metric set, so the reported redis connectivity failure cannot be confirmed or timed from metrics.
Failure behaviour of ad, recommendation, quote, accounting and fraud-detection was not examined and remains unknown.
next_steps: Compare the same queries against a baseline window to determine whether the 119-148 s errored PlaceOrder durations and the EmptyCart/redis failures are anomalous or recurring.
Have a human investigate the 0-valued checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR span-metric series versus the ERROR-tagged checkout spans to resolve which view reflects the true error count.
Check redis/valkey/cart infrastructure health and cart service logs for the 'Wasn't able to connect to redis' failure, using data sources outside the authorized metric set.
